description: Generate a self-contained HTML report of a workflow run. No args: list all runs. run_id: detailed report for that run with agent sequence, cost breakdown, and collapsible transcripts. Save the returned HTML to a file and open in a browser.

include_transcripts.description: Include full session transcripts in run reports (default: true, requires session persistence)

run_id.description: Generate detailed report for this run. Omit to list all runs.

name: claude_code_report
